t: Manufactured from stable, glass fibre-reinforced plastic with multi-component, ergonomic pistol grip for easy cutting, stripping and longitudinal cutting of the sheath. Spring-opening aid offers easy insertion of coax and data cable, and simplified insertion of single wires for stripping using location ridges. Conical, slimmed down tool ends for access in confined areas, with stripping device for cross-sections 0.2-4mm². Can be used for fast, precise dismantling and stripping of all common round and damp-proof installation cables such as NYM cable 3 x 1.5 - 5 x 2.5mm², data cable such as twisted pair, and coax cable. Capacity for round: 8-13mm, conductors & stands: 0.2-4.0mm. data: CAT 5-7, twisted pair (UTP/STP) and coax: 4.8-7.5mm.
